what.text: This page follows refugees from Afghanistan living in Brazil, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7592 Afghan refugees in Brazil, 0.3% of all refugees from Afghanistan.
Pakistan and Iran host the most Afghan refugees, followed by Germany and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan in every year from 1995 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025 and an interstate armed conflict with Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Brazil.
These are year-end totals for Brazil only, reported to UNHCR.
